reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Go module path is now `github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2`: As this release is a major version bump that has breaking changes, the rules for Go modules…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Go code importing crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update the go.mod module path and all import statements to the v2 module path when moving to v2+.
consequence.remediation: Update go.mod and all imports to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2.

proposed.statement: The Go module path changed to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 (and crossplane-runtime/v2); Go consumers must update go.mod and all import statements.
